jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Plane**
===============

Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 63,000+ stars, 6,500+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.

Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.

**Humans and agents**
---------------------

We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.

Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives.

This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that.

**About the role**
------------------

Plane ships one product to three very different buyers: a team that signs up on Cloud in a minute, an organization that runs it on its own infrastructure, and one that runs it on machines with no internet connection. The same release has to be explained to all three, and the differences between what each one gets are real. You own the messaging system underneath that: what we claim for Projects, Wiki, Intake, and Plane AI, the proof behind each claim, and how a launch reaches the site, the docs, Sales, and the community as one story rather than three. You will work with product managers on what shipped, with Sales on the objections that decide enterprise deals, and with the community, who file an issue when a marketing page overstates the product.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own positioning for Projects, Wiki, Intake, and Plane AI, and the source of truth for every claim and the proof behind it. When someone asks whether we can say something, you decide.
* Own how capability maps to edition and tier. Cloud, self-hosted commercial, and air-gapped customers get different things, and the page has to say which.
* Lead launches end to end: narrative, plan, page, announcement, email, in-product copy, and enablement, closed out with a review that names what moved and changes the next launch.
* Own the product, solution, industry, and comparison pages. These get read mid-evaluation against Jira, Asana, Monday.com, and ClickUp by people who use the competitor daily.
* Run the research the positioning rests on: customer and prospect interviews, lost-deal reasons, community threads, and competitive moves, turned into language we can publish.
* Work weekly with product managers, design, Sales, and the community team, and take contested claims to the engineer who built the feature before they ship.
* Maintain the library that goes stale on its own: battlecards, edition explainers, demo scripts, and FAQs. Check claims against the docs one page at a time before every launch, because an overstated claim returns as a support ticket or a lost deal.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* **You have owned positioning that changed results.** You can name the product, the claim you changed, and what moved after: adoption, conversion, or win rate.
* **You ship the copy, not only the brief.** Web-ready pages and launch assets that went live under your name.
* **You have run launches across functions.** You have held a date with product, design, Sales, and support attached to it, and you can describe one that went badly and what you changed.
* **You can hold your own with technical audiences and enterprise buyers.** You have written for developers and IT without distorting the product, and sat in evaluations where security and deployment decided the outcome.
* **You work from evidence.** Customer interviews, sales calls, and product data, used to settle positioning arguments.

**Nice to haves**
-----------------

* You have marketed an open-source or open-core product, where the community reads the code and corrects the page.
* You have shipped multi-edition software where capability differs by deployment.
* You have written security, compliance, and deployment narratives: SSO, audit…

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

  

**Manager, Business Intelligence**

  

We are hiring a Manager, Business Intelligence to lead reporting and analytics, standardize how the business measures itself, and respect the manual work that keeps reporting accurate today.

  

**Role overview:**

  

This role exists to turn a patchwork of manual, spreadsheet-driven reporting into a trusted, consistent reporting and analytics function, without losing the business knowledge embedded in those manual processes.

The Manager, Business Intelligence will keep critical manual reports running accurately while the team builds toward standard definitions, reusable data assets and self-service. The ideal candidate has done manual reporting hands-on, understands why it exists, and knows which tasks to automate, which to standardize and which to keep manual for now.

The role splits roughly as follows:

* **Reporting and analytics delivery (about 40%):** recurring, ad hoc and executive reporting, plus insight generation

* **Standardization and governance (about 30%):** KPI definitions, templates, documentation, report rationalization

* **Team leadership and stakeholder management (about 30%):** people development, intake, prioritization, communication

  

**Key responsibilities:**

  

**Reporting and analytics delivery**

* Own the recurring reporting calendar (weekly, monthly, quarter-end), including reports that are still built manually in Excel or similar tools.

* Ensure manual reports are accurate, reconciled and documented, and run them hands-on when the team needs support or when a process is not yet ready to automate.

* Deliver ad hoc analysis and executive reporting that explains what changed, why it changed and what to do next.

* Build and maintain dashboards and scorecards in the enterprise BI platform (for example Power BI or Tableau).

Translate business questions into clear requirements, data pulls and decision-ready insights.  

  

**Standardization and governance**

* Define and maintain standard KPIs and metric definitions across business units, with a single source of truth for each.

* Create reporting templates, a data dictionary and standard operating procedures for recurring reports.

* Review the current report inventory, retire duplicates and consolidate overlapping reports.

* Partner with data engineering and IT on data quality, data models and a governed semantic layer.

Set a clear path from manual to automated: prioritize what to automate by effort, risk and business value.  

  

**Team leadership**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of analysts and report developers; set goals and run regular feedback.

* Set team standards for quality, peer review, version control and documentation.

* Manage workload, intake and prioritization so urgent requests do not displace planned improvements.

Manage offshore, vendor or contractor resources where applicable.  

  

**Stakeholder management and change:**

* Act as the main point of contact for business partners on reporting and analytics needs.

* Run governance forums or a reporting council to agree on definitions and priorities.

* Lead adoption of standard reports and self-service, working with teams who rely on their own spreadsheets rather than overriding them.

* Communicate changes, outages and data caveats clearly and early.

**Continuous improvement:**

* Track reporting turnaround time, error rates, manual effort hours and user adoption.

* Introduce automation and process improvements where they pay back, and document the results.

Keep up with BI tooling and practice, and recommend upgrades where they help the business.  

  

**Required qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* 10 or more years of total experience in business intelligence, reporting or analytics, including at least 3 years leading people or teams, and a progression from hands-on analyst or developer work into senior ownership of reporting.

* Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, Power Query, lookup functions; VBA or macros a plus), with real experience running manual reporting processes.

* Strong SQL skills for extracting, joining and validating data from multiple sources.

* Hands-on experience with an enterprise BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker or Qlik, including dashboard design.

* Proven track record of standardizing KPIs or reports across multiple teams or business units, with examples of reduced report counts, faster turnaround or higher data trust, and the experience to set reporting strategy and roadmap rather than only execute it.

* Experience with data quality, reconciliation and controls on reports used for management or financial decisions.

* Ability to write clear requirements and documentation, including SOPs and data definitions.

Excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting insights to senior leaders.  

  

**Preferred qualifications:**

  

* Master's degree or an analytics, data or business certification (for example a Microsoft Power BI certification).

* Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Azure Synapse, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks.

* Experience with DAX, data modelling and a semantic layer.

* Experience with automation and ETL tools such as Alteryx, Power Automate, Azure Data Factory, SSIS or dbt.

* Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis and automation.

* Process improvement training (Lean or Six Sigma) or a track record of formal process redesign.

Experience building a reporting center of excellence or a self-service analytics program.

You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale. This is not a pillar-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end-to-end.
  
  
You'll report directly to the Product Director and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact. This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.
  
  
Strategic ownership
  
  

* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities

Execution leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively

Partnership with platform PMs
  
  

* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success

**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
AI-native products or features that users love
  
  

* Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on)
* Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization
* Cross-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas
* Experiences that balance power with usability.

Core capabilities
  
  

* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.

Nice to have
  
  

* Shipped copilot or AI-assisted features in a production SaaS product
* Experience with LLM cost optimization, latency budgeting, or inference infrastructure
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow, process automation, or BPM domains
* Track record of shipping cross-functional initiatives with competing stakeholders

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Netenrich**

Netenrich boosts the effectiveness of organizations’ security and digital operations so they can avoid disruption and manage risk.
**Resolution Intelligence Cloud™ (RIC)**
is our cloud-native, multitenant data analytics and agentic operations platform built for enterprises and managed service providers. By combining
**Praxis**
intelligent data pipelines,
**ActonLake™**
, and specialized AI agents, Resolution Intelligence Cloud transforms raw security and operational telemetry into high-fidelity intelligence that organizations can act on before critical issues occur. Enterprises and service providers rely on Netenrich to deliver Adaptive Autonomous Security Operations (ASO) at scale.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, technical
**Product Manager**
to own and drive product innovation for
**Adaptive Autonomous Security Operations (ASO)**
on our Resolution Intelligence Cloud™ platform.

Unlike traditional project-focused roles, this position sits at the intersection of
**deep cybersecurity engineering, Agentic AI innovation, and Go-To-Market (GTM) evangelism**
. You will shape the future of how modern SOCs move away from legacy alert fatigue toward autonomous detection, Likelihood-Impact-Confidence (LIC) risk scoring, and machine-speed containment—and you will take those innovations directly to market by partnering with sales, pre-sales, and enterprise customers to articulate and sell the tangible value of our platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Product Vision, Strategy & Innovation (Adaptive ASO)

* **Own the Adaptive ASO Roadmap:**
  Define and execute the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for Autonomous Security Operations on Resolution Intelligence Cloud™.
* **Drive Agentic AI Innovation:**
  Spearhead next-generation capabilities across
  **Agentic Entity Groups**
  ,
  **Risky Behaviour modelling**
  ,
  **LIC (Likelihood, Impact, Confidence) dynamic scoring**
  , and closed-loop automated remediation (Acton's).
* **Outpace Machine-Speed Adversaries:**
  Tackle the defining SecOps challenge of today—adversaries are leveraging AI and automation to strike at machine speed while traditional defences remain trapped in manual, human-speed triage. You will build autonomous workflows that close this asymmetry, turning multi-tenant alert noise, zero-MFA blind spots, and complex cloud telemetry into instant, high-confidence containment.

2. Go-To-Market (GTM) & Value Evangelism

* **Take Innovation to Market:**
  Act as the primary product evangelist for Adaptive ASO. Partner closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and Enterprise Pre-Sales to craft compelling value propositions, positioning, and competitive differentiation.
* **Customer & Partner Engagement:**
  Lead executive briefings, product demonstrations, and discovery sessions with CISOs, SOC Directors, and strategic MSSP/MDR partners to validate product-market fit and drive adoption.
* **Enablement & Storytelling:**
  Build high-impact solution decks, ROI narratives, interactive demos, and technical sales playbooks that clearly communicate
  *why*
  our feature innovations outperform traditional SIEM/SOAR and MDR offerings.

3. Cross-Functional Execution & Delivery

* **Partner with Engineering & Threat Research:**
  Work side-by-side with platform architects, AI/ML engineers, and threat detection researchers to translate market requirements into crisp PRDs, user stories, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* **Data-Driven Prioritization:**
  Continuously monitor platform telemetry, investigator efficacy metrics, and customer feedback loops to prioritize high-ROI features and refine product performance.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline.
* **Core Experience:**
  **6+ years**
  in Product Management or Technical Product Leadership within the
  **Cybersecurity, MDR, SIEM, SOAR, or Cloud Security (CNAPP/CDR)**
  space.
* **Deep SecOps Domain Mastery:**
  Hands-on familiarity with modern SOC workflows, MITRE ATT&CK frameworks, threat intelligence, log ingestion pipelines (e.g., Google SecOps/Chronicle, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), and cloud security ecosystems.
* **Commercial & GTM Acumen:**
  Proven track record of not just building technical features but taking them to market—demonstrated ability to pitch complex technical architectures to executive buyers, support enterprise deals, and articulate business value.
* **AI & Data Fluency:**
  Strong understanding of how AI/ML, behavioural analytics, and big data architectures apply to noise reduction and autonomous incident triage.
* **Communication & Leadership:**
  Exceptional storytelling, executive presence, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence engineering teams, sales leaders, and enterprise customers across global time zones (US & India).
* **Certifications (Preferred):**
  Pragmatic Institute (PMC), Certified Product Manager (CPM), CISSP, CISM, or cloud security certifications (AWS/GCP/Azure).

What We Offer

* **Category-Defining Innovation:**
  Work at the forefront of Agentic SOC and Autonomous Digital Operations on a platform processing petabyte of live enterprise telemetry.
* **High Visibility & Ownership:**
  Direct impact on company revenue, enterprise adoption, and platform direction with close access to executive leadership.
* **Collaborative Culture:**
  An inclusive, fast-paced engineering and product environment that values bold thinking, customer obsession, and continuous growth.

If interested, send your resume to narendra.raju@netenrich.com;

At Sanofi, we are an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system — and innovative pipeline — enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.

The
**OneLIMS program**
is a strategic global initiative to modernize and standardize Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) across Sanofi's entire worldwide QC laboratory network. The
**OneLIMS Product Line Manager**
owns the OneLIMS solution as a digital product — including
**Core LIMS**
,
**LES (Laboratory Execution System)**

* Change management: experience driving adoption of digital products in complex, matrixed organizations

jobs.title: Go-to-Market Global Operations, Sales Tools & Technologies Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**A) Who You’ll Work With**
===========================

On our team, we build and run the systems that help Teradata’s sellers, marketers, services teams, and partners win and serve customers. Salesforce is the system of record for our go-to-market engine, spanning accounts, opportunities, pipeline, forecasting, quoting, and customer engagement. You will own that platform as a product.

You will partner closely with Sales, Sales Operations and Revenue Operations, Marketing, Customer Success, Global Services, Finance, Legal and Privacy, and Technology Services platform administrators and developers. You will also work alongside other product owners on the Business Technology team to keep Salesforce integrated with the broader systems landscape, including Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, marketing automation, and learning systems. This position reports to the Senior Manager, Business Technology.

**B) What You’ll Do**
=====================

As the Salesforce Product Owner, you will translate business and user needs into clear, prioritized requirements, guide delivery in an agile model, and measure whether the platform is improving how Teradata sells and serves. Success means a Salesforce environment that is reliable, easy to use, well governed, and visibly tied to revenue and productivity outcomes.

Key responsibilities:

* Support the execution of the Salesforce product roadmap and backlog, prioritizing features, enhancements, and fixes based on business value, user impact, and risk.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria; lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and daily scrums with platform admins, developers, and implementation partners.
* Own requirements across Salesforce clouds and capabilities in use (such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, reporting and forecasting, and Agentforce/AI features), including release readiness and user acceptance testing.
* Own requirements for integrations with adjacent systems, including SSO (Microsoft Entra ID), Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, Microsoft 365 and Teams, marketing automation, and data platforms; coordinate design, testing, and release.
* Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to streamline lead-to-cash and opportunity-to-quote processes, reducing manual effort and improving data quality and forecast accuracy.
* Define and maintain data standards, object and field governance, and metadata ownership; oversee data quality, deduplication, and hygiene for accounts, contacts, and opportunities.
* Drive adoption and governance of AI-enabled capabilities, including usage controls, cost tracking, and responsible-use guardrails.
* Build and track platform KPIs (user adoption, data quality, process cycle time, release quality, user satisfaction) and deliver reporting and dashboards to stakeholders and leadership.
* Run intake and triage for enhancement requests and incidents, manage the Salesforce vendor and implementation partner relationships, and publish release notes.
* Manage the Salesforce seasonal release cycle, evaluating new functionality and sequencing change to minimize disruption and maximize adoption.
* Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Compliance to keep the platform aligned with data protection requirements, access controls, and regional obligations.
* Create admin and end-user enablement, and support change management and communications for platform updates.

**C) What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**
===========================================

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 4–6 years of experience in product ownership, business systems, or CRM, including at least 2 years owning, administering, or configuring Salesforce in an enterprise environment.
* Hands-on experience managing a product backlog and writing user stories in an agile/Scrum environment.
* Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model, declarative configuration (Flow, validation rules, permission sets), and integration patterns including REST/SOAP APIs, SSO/SAML, and middleware.
* Strong analytical skills; able to build Salesforce reports and dashboards, interpret pipeline and adoption data, and turn metrics into decisions.
* Proven stakeholder management across business, IT, and vendor teams, with the ability to balance competing priorities and say no with data.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including presenting to senior leaders.

**D) What You’ll Bring**
========================

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), or similar certification.
* Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, or CPQ Specialist (strongly preferred).
* Experience with CRM implementations, migrations, or multi-org consolidation, and with quote-to-cash processes.
* Familiarity with AI and generative AI capabilities in CRM (such as Agentforce and Einstein), and interest in applying them responsibly.
* Experience with Jira, ServiceNow, and reporting tools such as Power BI or SQL.
* Understanding of data privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR) as they apply to customer and prospect data.
* Exposure to Workday, CPQ, ERP/Finance, or Microsoft 365 integrations.
* A customer- and seller-first, systems-oriented mindset, and the initiative to keep making the platform better. By owning Salesforce, you will directly shape how Teradata’s teams sell, serve, and succeed.

jobs.description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.

Overview:

**About the Role**

We're hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager for our Product & Engineering organization. You'll own two areas:

* **Product delivery and release readiness** for Seismic software (including Highspot by Seismic): making sure features ship on time, at quality, with go-to-market teams ready on day one.
* **Technical programs** that span teams, such as localization workflows, architecture upgrades, and other technical initiatives.

You'll work across Engineering, Product, Design, Product Marketing and customer-facing teams. You'll turn ambitious goals into clear plans, make tradeoffs visible, and keep programs moving without needing formal authority.

Who you are::

**Required**

* 5+ years as a Technical Program Manager or in a similar role in B2B SaaS, leading complex cross-functional programs.
* Experience managing the full software development lifecycle and go-to-market readiness for product launches. Critically, you have delivered not only internal projects, but you have overseen feature/product delivery to external customers.
* Deep experience with agile/scrum, and judgment about when to adapt process for a large, complex organization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Data-driven: you use metrics to make decisions, surface risks and measure success. You're comfortable getting data yourself with tools like Amplitude, SQL and Snowflake.
* Hands-on use of AI tools to automate workflows, speed up delivery and remove manual work. Please share examples in your application.
* Flexibility working across time zones, in particular coordinating across North America and sometimes China.

**Nice to have**

* Experience leading change management or new technology adoption across an organization.
* Experience with Jira/Confluence, LaunchDarkly, Salesforce, and sales enablement products.
* PMP, CSM, SAFe or similar certification.

What you'll be doing::

**Product delivery & release readiness**

* Own end-to-end program management for a core product feature area across multiple engineering teams in different geos, keeping a predictable delivery cadence.
* Run the release readiness process: drive sign-off from Engineering, QE, Security and other functions, and make sure features are high quality and well documented.
* Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, Support and Technical Account Managers so customer-facing teams are enabled and customers are set up for success at launch.

**Technical programs**

* Lead internal and/or customer-facing technical programs from definition through delivery: set scope, build the plan, line up owners and drive adoption.
* Lead change management for new processes and tools, including stakeholder alignment, communication, training and measuring adoption.

**Across both**

* Define and track program metrics and business KPIs, and give stakeholders and leadership clear, concise status.
* Spot risks and dependencies early, raise them with options, and drive them to resolution.
* Find manual, repetitive program work and automate it, including with AI tools.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First** **90 days****:** Own the release calendar for a major product area (to be determined), establish relationships across functions and run at least one release end to end.
* **First year:** Releases are predictable and GTM teams are consistently ready at launch. At least one technical program is delivered with measurable adoption.

Job Posting Footer:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about making operations run smoother and more efficiently? Amazon is looking for a Process Improvement Specialist to join our EU FBA Support Operations team, where you will identify opportunities to enhance workflows, reduce waste, and drive meaningful results. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional partners to build and implement solutions that directly impact team performance and the associate experience.  
  
You will bring a data-informed mindset and a knack for problem-solving to tackle real operational challenges. Whether you are analyzing process metrics, creating new standard operating procedures, or coordinating with stakeholders to roll out improvements, your contributions will help us deliver for customers more effectively every day. If you are a curious, detail-oriented self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.  
  
A successful candidate must be able to work independently, thrive in ambiguous environments, effectively influence internal/external partners at all levels of the organization. This role will particularly suit someone with a strong innovative mindset, relationship building skills, operational excellence, superior project management capabilities, and strong people management experience.  
  
Some of the qualities that we are looking for: you are results-oriented (and have a track record of repeatedly delivering great results); you are an innovator (and have already proven it); you have the intellect and horsepower to solve really complex problems (some may say impossible to solve); you are an owner, and do what it takes to make your team successful; you have relentlessly high standards (some may say too high); you are customer obsessed; you operate well in an ambiguous environment; and finally, you have a burning desire to be a part of something really big.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Analyze operational data and process metrics to identify inefficiencies, points of failure, and improvement opportunities within fulfillment center workflows.
* Build and implement process improvement initiatives that enhance team outputs, including developing standard operating procedures and automating repetitive tasks where possible.
* Collaborate with peers, managers, and partner teams to troubleshoot operational issues, escalate risks, and align on solutions that balance time and resources.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to communicate project status, track progress, and drive alignment on improvement plans, ensuring clear and concise updates across all levels.
* Monitor system performance and service levels through defined metrics, using findings to refine processes and sustain long-term operational gains.
* Support development and implementation of Automation through data-driven analysis by coordinating with wider organization and tracking progress
* Identify and implement sustainable improvements for operational excellence using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies
* Execute strategic projects that deliver improvements in Seller Experience, productivity, and lowest cost-to-serve for Selling Partners and Amazon
* Collaborate with program stakeholders to clarify requirements and objectives. Support writing business and technical requirements documents
* Support establishment of business goals, metrics and key performance indicators (KPI) for success
* Build relationships with key stakeholders across global product, program and operational teams to support scalable solutions

  
A day in the life  
A typical day for an EU FBA Process Improvement Specialist will focus on executing Seller Experience initiatives and reduce Cost to Serve for Sellers and for Amazon, analyzing data to drive efficiency improvements, and collaborating with global teams to enhance seller services. They'll split their work between identifying process gaps, performing execution support, implementing process improvements using Lean/Six Sigma methods. jobs.title: Senior Principal - Product Owner - Cloud
jobs.description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Product Owner - Cloud owns the backlog and roadmap for the Cloud platform, and all Cloud services translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output. Products span cloud, network, digital workplace and AI Hub domains, and the specific product is set on appointment.
  
  
The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering. This is an insourced role under the DPTF sourcing decisions, so it is not delivered through a managed service partner.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Experience delivering Cloud Services as a Product Owner or equivalent member of an Agile team
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Experience using Jira or a similar backlog management tool.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standards grounds.

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.  
We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.  
For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).  
‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency  
Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

You'll work with global finance & functional teams and report to the Analytics Hub Manager.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics or Engineering.

**Experience**

* 4+ years of hands-on quantitative analytics experience, focused on business analysis rather than IT delivery.
* A track record of working in a fast-paced environment, managing competing requests and prioritizing well.

**Technical Skills**

* **Must have:** Strong skills in **Power BI, Tableau, SQL and Excel**
* **Good to have:** Python and/or R, Alteryx
* Deep knowledge of advanced analytics methods and the ability to turn data into recommendations.
* Working understanding of data science principles and machine learning.
* Comfortable collaborating virtually across voice, video, web conferencing and messaging tools.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Team-oriented, with an ownership mindset and a focus on outcomes.
* Driven by numbers and data, highly analytical and detail-oriented.
* Willing to roll up your sleeves and dig into problems.
* Strong communicator who raises and resolves issues proactively.

**Working Relationships**

* Reports to the Analytics Manager, Analytics Hub.
* Works closely with the offshore analytics team and the offshore Analytics Manager.

**Some benefits of working with us**

* Access to a huge array of internal and external training courses on our learning system (free)
* Access to self-paced language training (free)
* Birthday or wedding anniversary gift of INR 1500
* Charity work once a year, to give back to the community
* Company car, phone if required for role
* Competitive health and wellness benefit plan
* Continuous professional development with numerous opportunities for growth
* Creche facility
* Employee Business Resource Groups (EBRGs)
* Electric car charging stations
* Hybrid work arrangement eg. 3 days in office
* Internet allowance
* No-meeting Fridays
* Parking on site (free)
* Relocation assistance available
* Staff hangout spaces, enjoy games like carrom, chess
* Transport by cab if working the midnight – 7am shift
* Well connected to public transport, only a 10 min walk to office

We understand that candidates will not meet every single desired job requirement. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve identified and you think you can bring value to the role, we’d love to learn more about *you.*

jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-plus-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, advisory, and consulting groups as well as our enabling services functions. That’s why we continually invest in innovation, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an **Agentic Business Process Analyst** to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.

The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent-enabled processes.

This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end-to-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first-time-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value-led, AI-enabled transformation work.

**What success looks like**

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

jobs.title: Kirana Club : Product Manager II - Commerce
jobs.description:
### **About the role**

You will own critical retailer-commerce journeys on Kirana Club, from product discovery and decision-making to checkout and repeat purchase. Your first and most important mandate will be to improve retailer activation—moving retailers from their first to fourth delivered order. This is an ambiguous, cross-functional problem spanning product experience, assortment, pricing, trust, fulfilment and user behaviour. You will be expected to identify where the real constraint lies, determine what product should solve, and build solutions that materially improve the business outcome.

### **What you'll do**

* Own the product roadmap for retailer activation, with an immediate focus on first-order conversion and progression from the first to fourth delivered order.
* Diagnose funnel and behavioural problems through data, user research and market visits rather than starting with predetermined features.
* Build and test solutions across discovery, product comprehension, cart, checkout, assisted buying, post-order and repeat journeys.
* Work closely with Growth, Design, Engineering, Data, Supply and Fulfilment, while distinguishing product problems from pricing, assortment and operational problems.
* Define success metrics, make clear product trade-offs and measure impact on delivered orders and repeat behaviour—not only clicks or feature adoption.
* Build scalable product systems rather than relying primarily on notifications, discounts or manual interventions.

### **What we're looking for**

* 6–9 years of total experience, including at least 4–6 years in product management, preferably in consumer commerce, marketplaces, fintech, quick commerce or another transactional product.
* Has independently owned a meaningful conversion, activation, retention, monetisation or transactional-funnel metric.
* Strong first-principles problem solver who can structure an ambiguous problem before jumping to solutions.
* Comfortable combining behavioural data, qualitative research and commercial understanding.
* Has built or materially improved a zero-to-one consumer journey, not only optimised an established feature backlog.
* Strong execution in a resource-constrained environment and comfortable working directly with business and operating teams.
* AI-native in research, analysis, prototyping and day-to-day product execution.

Advances in generative and agentic AI create an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how sellers operate their businesses — moving from dashboards and workflows, toward intelligent experiences that understand their business, identify what needs attention, recommend actions and increasingly execute work on their behalf.  
  
As the Product Manager for SmartHub, you will be at the forefront of defining and executing this journey by identifying the opportunities, defining the product and deliver exceptional seller experiences. Your work will directly impact the growth and success of sellers leveraging Amazon SmartHub, enabling them to scale their business to new heights.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Understand seller problems to identify unmet needs and emerging trends in the e-commerce landscape.

  

* Monitor and analyze competitor activities and market trends to identify opportunities for differentiation and innovation.

  

* Translate seller insights and market opportunities into detailed product requirements and user stories for the engineering team.

  

* Collaborate with GTM, engineering, UX, support and marketing teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from concept to launch.

  

* Analyze product performance data, identify areas for improvement, and iterate on the product based on customer feedback and business results.

  

* Conduct A/B testing and other experiments to optimize product features and improve key metrics.

  

* Develop and maintain product documentation, including user guides, training materials, and FAQs.

  
Required Skillset:  
  

* Proven ability to conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer insights to inform product strategy.

  

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, draw conclusions, and make data-driven decisions.

  

* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across teams.

  

* Deep understanding of online product management principles, agile development methodologies, and A/B testing techniques.

  

* Bachelor's degree in a related field; MBA preferred with 3years of experience in product management

  
A day in the life  
You will start your day by reviewing the product and business metrics. You morning might involve speaking to a seller processing thousands of orders across Amazon, Flipkart and other channels, identifying where manual work and exceptions slow them down. Later, you could work with engineers and scientists on an AI agent that detects inventory risks or automates an operational workflow. You will move fluidly between speaking to sellers, thinking of solutions, brainstorming with engineers, driving adoption and thinking strategy.  
  
About the team  
Amazon Smart Commerce is building the technology infrastructure for agentic commerce that helps businesses sell and operate wherever their customers shop.  
  
SmartHub is our multi-channel operations platform, helping sellers bring orders, inventory, catalog, returns and business insights from multiple marketplaces and D2C channels into one system. It is built for the operational realities of commerce - high-volume events, warehouse workflows, complex integrations and businesses that cannot afford downtime.  
  
We believe AI creates an opportunity to reinvent this category. Our ambition is to evolve from a software that helps sellers manage workflows to an intelligent commerce operating system that helps them run and grow their businesses.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of product management experience
* Experience managing technical products or online services

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services
* Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization
* Experience in creating PRFAQs, BRDs and other product documentation. Experience in leveraging AI for documentation, prototyping and business data analysis.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.description:
**Description**
As a Senior Product Manager - Tech on Amazon's seller support platform, you'll own the foundation that every support decision runs on: the routing engine that decides where each seller's issue goes, the case record that follows that issue across teams and systems, and the controls that govern who can change what. The platform serves more than 220 teams across support, investigation, and compliance, and today many of them route and store cases their own way. A seller can get passed between teams, retell their problem, or wait while their history sits in another tool. Your job is to fix that at the platform level. You'll define how one routing engine serves many organizations without becoming a bottleneck, and how it decides whether an issue goes to an AI agent or a person. You'll decide what a case carries when it moves between teams and which systems stay in sync. You'll design an access model that gives specialists the full picture they need, and nothing more. As AI takes on more of the work, the issues that reach people are the hardest ones, so getting the foundation right matters more, not less. Much of this hasn't been defined yet. You'll work backwards from sellers, associates, and the teams who configure routing. You'll partner with engineers, security, and product leaders, and be the main product voice for the engineering teams you sit with. Expect ambiguity, hard trade-offs between flexibility and control, and regular conversations with senior leaders about where the platform goes next.
  
  
**About The Team**
Paragon is the core issue management platform for Selling Partner Support, serving 220+ teams across support, investigation, and compliance. We build products spanning issue intelligence, content management, AI-powered auditing, workforce development, and intelligent routing. Our vision is mostly autonomous issue resolution with selective human intervention, where associates evolve into specialists whose judgment continuously improves the AI systems they supervise.

International Payments (i18n) takes Razorpay’s products into these markets: local payment methods, cross-border flows, and the partnerships with banks, wallets and schemes that make them work — on top of a platform and systems layer that has to be rebuilt for each market’s rails, currency, regulation and settlement cycle. This is a builder role as much as a product role. In a new market, Razorpay has no brand recall and few relationships, so you will open doors yourself and because a new market means new rails, you will also own the systems underneath — machinery that every downstream product depends on.

* You are comfortable working hands-on in a fast-paced start-up environment.
* You are curious about metrics, execution processes, macro trends.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager-Tech, Amazon Supply Chain Services
jobs.description:
**Description**
Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), which includes Multichannel Commerce Fulfillment (MCCF), lets merchants use Amazon’s fulfilment and logistics network to reach customers wherever they shop: their own websites, social commerce, other marketplaces and wholesale. Our vision is to enable every entrepreneur in the world to reach every customer in the world through every channel they can imagine. Through Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF), Buy with Prime (BwP), Multi-Channel Distribution (MCD) and Warehousing & Logistics, merchants keep products in stock, ship faster and more reliably, and lower their costs. For over 20 years Amazon has helped small and medium-sized businesses grow on Amazon; ASCS is how we help merchants of every size grow beyond it.
  
  
As ASCS scales, how merchants find, choose and get more out of it matters as much as what it offers. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager–Technical (Sr. PMT) to shape how ASCS grows with merchants: understanding why merchants who would benefit are not yet using our services, building the products and platforms that change that, and proving what actually moves the business. You will pair strategic vision with hands-on execution, working across engineering, business, finance and data science teams to build products fundamental to Amazon’s future.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
> Product strategy & direction: Continuously assess the needs of our customers and partners in defining and evolving the product and business strategy. Identify where ASCS services create the most value for merchants and translate those insights into a clear, differentiated product direction across marketing and pricing surfaces.
  
  
> Roadmap planning: Deliver world-class innovation in features, usability, and performance in a consistent release cadence. Be the internal and external authority for your program, driving value-based prioritisation from concept to launch to maximise ROI.
  
  
> Requirements definition: Develop comprehensive product plans incorporating merchant needs, competitive context, and business objectives. Produce high-quality requirements docs and manage scope to deliver key capabilities on time.
  
  
> Technical collaboration: Partner with engineering to craft BRDs, influence the design and architecture of technical solutions, and make informed trade-off decisions that balance merchant impact with implementation complexity.
  
  
> AI & productivity leverage: Apply AI tools to meaningfully accelerate product development from drafting and iterating on requirement document, merchant-facing messaging, to customer research, modelling pricing scenarios, and generating campaign briefs. You will actively identify where AI can compress timelines and improve output quality across the product lifecycle, and serve as a proponent of AI adoption within your cross-functional teams.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
> Collaborate with GTM, Sales, User Research, Tech, Finance, and Operations to define strategy, vision, and features for MCF and ASCS adoption.
  
  
> Own the product backlog and BRDs across marketing and pricing workstreams; prioritize and make feature trade-offs that maximize merchant adoption and ROI.
  
  
> Deliver products end-to-end across Engineering, Legal, Information Security, UX, and Finance from concept through launch.
  
  
> Design, launch, and iterate on lifecycle automation and targeted campaigns to engage and convert unmanaged merchants at scale.
  
  
> Communicate charter vision, roadmap, and business impact to senior leadership
  
  
**About The Team**
ASCS helps merchants of every size reach customers on any channel through Multi-Channel Fulfillment, Buy with Prime, Multi-Channel Distribution and Warehousing & Logistics. The ASCS Monetisation team owns how this business earns while keeping merchants’ trust. We set what merchants pay through rate cards, fees, discounts, incentives and negotiated pricing. We make merchants whole when inventory or orders are lost, damaged or returned. OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
YOUR IMPACT
  
At OpenText, the AI-native Product Development Lifecycle is changing how customer needs are understood, products are defined and product intent becomes working software. BMAD is a core framework in this transformation, using specialized agents, structured context and defined artifacts to connect discovery, product definition, UX, architecture, stories and implementation. As an AI-PDLC Product Coach, you will help Product Managers, Product Owners and UX partners use BMAD Definer workflows to create clear, evidence-grounded product context that Builder agents and Development teams can execute.This is a full-time, hands-on practitioner and transformation role, not a traditional training position or a general AI adoption role. You will work alongside teams to apply BMAD from idea clarification and discovery through PRDs, UX specifications, architecture handoffs, epics, stories and validation, helping teams adopt an agent-first approach while preserving product judgment, customer evidence and human accountability.
  
WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS
  
  

* Lead hands-on BMAD learning and embedded coaching for Product Managers, Product Owners and UX partners using real OpenText products, customer evidence and product workflows.
* Guide teams through BMAD Definer workflows spanning idea clarification, research, opportunity discovery, PRDs, UX specifications, prototypes, architecture collaboration, epics, stories, acceptance criteria and validation.

* Provide embedded coaching, office hours and targeted support that move teams beyond AI-assisted documentation toward BMAD-enabled, end-to-end product definition and delivery.

* Develop AI champions, facilitate showcases and peer learning, and contribute insights to the central AI-PDLC program.
* Work directly with Development Builders and Architects to ensure BMAD outputs provide the context, decisions and acceptance criteria required for reliable implementation and testing.
* Retain practical product delivery responsibility by helping teams create and validate real product definitions, prototypes and outcomes, rather than limiting the role to facilitation or document generation.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED
  
  

* Significant experience in Product Management, Product Ownership or a closely related product discipline within a technology or software environment.
* Strong, recent hands-on use of BMAD or comparable spec-driven, multi-agent product development frameworks, together with tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot or similar tools in real product work.
* Demonstrated experience configuring and applying BMAD agents, workflows and artifacts, or equivalent agentic methods, to take an idea through discovery, product definition, prototyping and validation.

* Ability to evaluate AI-generated product outputs for evidence, accuracy, customer relevance, strategic alignment, feasibility and requirements quality.

* Strong facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and coach practitioners with different levels of AI experience.

* Ability to explain and coach the BMAD operating model, including specialized agent roles, structured handoffs, context management, human decision points and right-sized workflows for different levels of complexity.
* Demonstrated track record of using AI and agentic workflows to deliver measurable improvements in productivity, cycle time, throughput, quality or other business outcomes, and successfully scaling those practices beyond an individual or team.
* A learning mindset and willingness to remain current as models, tools and AI-enabled product practices evolve.
* Success will include teams independently applying BMAD, producing consistent Definer-to-Builder handoffs, increasing the share of work delivered through governed agentic workflows, and achieving measurable gains in cycle time and quality.

jobs.title: Data Governance Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

**The Data Governance Manager owns the policies, standards, and stewardship model that keep data — real estate, consumer, and operational — accurate, compliant, and trustworthy for use across the business. This role sits within Technology and partners closely with Compliance, Enterprise Risk, and the data platform team to operationalize governance across Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and MongoDB environments. A defining requirement of this role is deep, hands-on fluency in real estate data (MLS, public record, tax assessor, deed/title) alongside other third-party data domains (demographics, geolocation).**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Define, publish, and maintain enterprise data governance policies, standards, and a data stewardship model covering ownership, quality, classification, and lifecycle management**
* **Build and maintain the enterprise data catalog, business glossary, and lineage maps in Microsoft Purview across source systems, Azure data stores, Fabric workspaces, and MongoDB collections**
* **Establish and monitor data quality rules, remediation workflows, and quality scorecards for critical data domains, with real estate and third-party data as top priorities**
* **Classify and label sensitive data** (PII, consumer, regulated real estate data) and enforce access controls and data loss prevention policies in partnership with Security and Compliance
* Chair a cross-functional data governance council with representation from Technology, Compliance, Enterprise Risk, and business data owners; drive adoption of governance policy across the organization
* Own governance requirements for third-party and vendor data agreements, including MLS licensing terms, public record data provider contracts, and demographic/geolocation data licenses
* Partner with Legal and Compliance to ensure data handling practices meet real estate industry regulations, consumer privacy law (e.g., CCPA/CPRA, GLBA, FCRA), and MLS/IDX rules
* Define and track data governance KPIs and maturity metrics; report governance posture and risk to executive leadership
* Support data platform initiatives (Customer 360, enterprise data lake, AI/ML programs) by ensuring underlying data meets governance and quality bars before use
* Provide governance guidance and training to data stewards, engineers, and analysts across the technology organization

**Real Estate Data Domain Expertise**

This role requires working knowledge of real estate data sources and the compliance obligations attached to them, including:

* MLS data: licensing and usage terms, IDX/VOW display rules, field-level restrictions, data syndication agreements, and MLS Grid or comparable aggregation standards
* Public record data: county assessor, tax roll, deed/title, foreclosure, and lien data — governing provenance, refresh cadence, accuracy validation, and jurisdictional variance across counties and states
* Valuation and transaction data: automated valuation model (AVM) inputs/outputs, comparable sales data, and title/escrow data, with attention to accuracy and defensibility given downstream business and consumer use
* Regulatory context: familiarity with real estate industry bodies and standards (NAR, MLS Grid, RESO Data Dictionary) and how they shape data usage rights and audit requirements
* Candidates should be able to speak to the governance challenges unique to real estate data — fragmented sourcing, inconsistent standards across MLSs and counties, and strict licensing terms — and to translate them into practical governance controls.

**Other Data Domain Expertise**

Beyond real estate, this role governs a range of third-party and derived data used across the business:

* Demographics: syndicated and census-derived consumer demographic data, including governance of aggregation level, licensing restrictions, and appropriate use in modeling and targeting
* Geolocation and geospatial data: geocoding accuracy, parcel and boundary data, coordinate reference standards, and spatial data quality across mapping and location-based use cases
* Third-party and vendor data generally: tracking usage rights, contractual restrictions, refresh obligations, and lineage from ingestion through downstream consumption, ensuring vendor data is cataloged and classified to the same standard as internally generated data
* Experience governing a mix of structured, semi-structured, and vendor-sourced data is important given the breadth of external data ingests.

**Technical Platform Expertise**

* **Microsoft Purview:** hands-on experience configuring data catalog scans, classification and sensitivity labels, business glossary, data lineage, DLP policies, and compliance/insider risk features across hybrid data estates
* Microsoft Azure: governance of data across Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, and Azure SQL, including access control (RBAC/ABAC), encryption, and monitoring
* **Microsoft Fabric:** governance within OneLake, lakehouses, pipelines, and semantic models, including domain and workspace-level governance and integration with Purview's unified catalog
* MongoDB: schema and metadata governance for document/NoSQL stores, including collection-level classification, indexing standards, and integration of MongoDB sources into the broader catalog and lineage picture
* Ability to design governance controls that work consistently across this mixed relational/lakehouse/NoSQL ecosystem, rather than treating each platform in isolation

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent experience considered
* 7+ years of progressive experience in data governance, data management, or data quality roles, including at least 2 years leading governance programs or teams
* Hands-on experience implementing and administering Microsoft Purview for cataloging, classification, and lineage in a production environment

Global Supply Chain is at the heart of GSK, manufacturing and supplying reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to patients around the world while driving our performance as a business. This team oversees the end-to-end supply network — from product, portfolio and network strategy through to operational delivery and distribution — ensuring that we meet patient needs efficiently, safely and sustainably across all our markets.
  
  
Supply Chain and Strategy within Global Supply Chain brings together planning, customer supply chain, external manufacturing, classic and established products, and other specialist teams into one connected organisation with full visibility across the supply chain. By joining this team, you’ll help build a world-class, data-driven and resilient supply chain ready for the future, combining science, technology and talent to make sure GSK’s products reach the people who need them, wherever they are.
